description: YouTube embed behind a facade: a thumbnail (or local poster) and one play button; the youtube-nocookie.com iframe loads only when the reader presses play. Without poster the thumbnail is requested from i.ytimg.com on render.

attributes.name: video-id
attributes.description: YouTube video ID (6–20 of A–Z a–z 0–9 _ -). Missing or invalid: the element does not upgrade and the authored fallback stays.

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: Video title: the iframe title and the {title} in the play-button name.

attributes.name: start
attributes.description: Start playback at N seconds. Whole non-negative seconds only; anything else is ignored with a console warning.

attributes.name: end
attributes.description: Stop playback at N seconds. Whole non-negative seconds only.

attributes.name: params
attributes.description: Extra query string for the embed URL (escape hatch); its keys override start, end, list and autoplay. The embed host is fixed.

attributes.name: autoplay
attributes.description: Load the iframe on connect instead of the facade (this contacts YouTube at once). Ignored under prefers-reduced-motion or data-motion-reduced. Never moves focus.

attributes.name: thumbnail
attributes.description: i.ytimg.com thumbnail size. sd and maxres fall back to hq when the video has none.

attributes.name: poster
attributes.description: Local image URL for the facade. When set, no thumbnail is requested from i.ytimg.com; nothing contacts Google until play.

attributes.name: data-label-play
attributes.description: Accessible name of the play button; {title} is replaced with the title.

attributes.name: state
attributes.description: Set by the component: ready = facade shown, active = iframe inserted. Reconnect (move or reinsert) renders the facade again.

events.name: youtube-player:activate
events.description: Fired (bubbles) when the iframe is inserted; fromUser is false for the autoplay attribute.
